items.title: Collect a tin of Cram
items.detail: Available at Summersville diner in the Forest

items.title: Complete an Event or Activity
items.detail: Public events spawn every 20 minutes on the map

items.title: Complete the Quest: Disturbed Grave
items.detail: Finish any public event first to get the map, then dig up the marked grave

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find the gray cloudy area on map, locate the red hotspot, kill Phantoms there

items.title: Kill an Angler
items.detail: Fast travel to Gnarled Shallows for reliable spawns, use V.A.T.S. for the head

items.title: Collect a box of Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese
Eat a box of Blamco Brand Mac and Cheese
Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Complete all six other daily challenges on three separate days

items.title: Build a Decoration in a Shelter
items.detail: Enter your C.A.M.P. shelter, place any decoration from the build menu

items.title: Catch a Fish
items.detail: Fish at any water source; Fisherman's Rest in the Mire is reliable

items.title: Collect RadAway or Rad-X
items.detail: Find in world loot or craft diluted forms at a chemistry station

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Find at Whitespring Resort showers and tables, or use Collectron station

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: Take from a Games Cupboard at your C.A.M.P. if you have one placed

items.title: Eat a Vegetable
items.detail: Harvest and eat any raw vegetable like Tato, Corn, or Razorgrain

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Enter Daily Ops, kill a Phantom; you don't need to finish the operation

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation
items.detail: Find gray cloudy infestation areas on map, locate hotspot, kill Phantoms
